summary.oneLiner: The deck positions Fiberweb as a pioneering, 100% export-oriented Indian manufacturer of spun bond and melt blown nonwoven fabrics, backed by a debt-light balance sheet and ongoing capacity/modernization investment.

hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Fiberweb as a pioneering, 100% export-oriented Indian manufacturer of spun bond and melt blown nonwoven fabrics, backed by a debt-light balance sheet and ongoing capacity/modernization investment.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Pioneer and among the leading players in India's spun bond nonwoven fabric manufacturing, established in 1985 (plant commissioned 1996) as the first of its kind in India.
- 100% Export Oriented Unit (EOU) with ~75% of products exported to the USA, UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa and the Gulf.
- Well-set supply chain sourcing most raw material from Exxon Mobil, described as the world's largest O&G company; manufacturing machines procured from Eisenhauer GMBH of Germany.
- Product quality backed by international accreditations: ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, OHSAS 18001, Intertek and UKAS certifications.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Company's milestone timeline states it became a 'Zero Debt company with positive net worth'; FY24-FY26 balance sheet shows zero long-term borrowings, though short-term borrowings of ₹6.87-12.02 Cr are carried.
- Net worth grew from ₹161.34 Cr (FY24) to ₹186.36 Cr (FY26) while fixed assets rose from ₹116.98 Cr to ₹145.27 Cr over the same period, consistent with capex funded via internal accruals.
- Promoter shareholding stands at 47.04%, with public holding at 52.96% (as on 30-06-2026).

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Credit Rating] Company holds ratings of IND BBB-/Stable for fund-based facilities and IND A3 for non-fund-based facilities.
- [Export Order] Company received an export order worth ₹10 Cr covering PP Spun Bond and Melt Blown Fabrics, per the company's milestone timeline.
- [Listing] Shares listed on the National Stock Exchange; share-price history on the Stock Information slide begins 16-02-2022.
